CustomField.description: What kind of data job this is: a file import, a bulk update or a bulk delete of the records a Find query returned, a field access change, or a Backup Set run (canonical model R-BU1, R-BD1, R-FA1, R-SQ15). Empty reads as Import.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Import loads a file. Update changes, and Delete deletes, the records a Find query returned. Access changes field access on permission sets. Backup saves a Backup Set to Files.
CustomField.label: Operation
